name: ZOUR x BITEZ Micros 3,000MG Gummies - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Strawberry Watermelon
description: Strawberry Watermelon delivers a smooth blend of sweet, refreshing fruit flavor. Ripe, sweet strawberry pairs with juicy watermelon for a bright, balanced combination with plenty of fruity sweetness in every bite. This Ocho Extracts x Zour Stash collab packs a 500mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend per gummy—half the potency of the original BITEZ for a smoother, more manageable experience (6 gummies per bag, 3,000mg total). Juicy strawberry and refreshing watermelon create a sweet, flavorful finish.
